title: OPN Healthcare notifies patients after unauthorized access to one business email account
date_note: The day the notice was reported to the California Attorney General (the register's Reported Date, 11/20/2026); the notice letter itself is undated. The notice says the unauthorized access was on or about 3 June 2026.
geo_basis: headquarters address on the notice letter (550 N Brand Blvd., Glendale, CA)
summary: OPN Healthcare, which coordinates oncology care for physicians and health insurers, filed a breach notice with California's Attorney General. Its letter says that on or about 3 June 2026 an unauthorized party briefly accessed emails in one business email account, and on 25 September 2026 it determined the emails contained some notified people's health information. OPN says no emails or attachments were downloaded and the emails held no Social Security numbers or addresses.
plain: An oncology care company in California says someone briefly got into one staff email account in June. The emails held some people's health details, though the company says nothing was downloaded.
exec: Business email compromise at a healthcare services firm exposed patient health information held on behalf of physicians and insurers.
action: OPN Healthcare's notice urges recipients to review account statements, explanation of benefits statements and credit reports for irregular activity; the letter lists a toll-free response line for questions.
impact: Number of people affected not stated in the notice or the register entry.

sources.name: California Attorney General: OPN Healthcare, Inc. breach notification and sample notice letter
OPN Healthcare notice letter (filed with the California AG)

report.publisher: OPN Healthcare, Inc. (filed with the California Attorney General)
key_findings: On or about June 3, 2026, an unauthorized party briefly accessed certain emails in one business email account.
On September 25, 2026, OPN determined the accessed files contained some recipients' health information.
OPN says no emails or attachments were downloaded; the emails held no Social Security numbers or addresses.
recommendations: Review financial account statements, explanation of benefits statements and credit reports for irregular activity.

evidence.quote: The investigation determined that on or about June 3, 2026, an unauthorized party briefly accessed certain emails within the affected email account.

validation.note: Primary: OPN Healthcare's own notice letter, filed with and published by the California Attorney General (register entry sb24-633250, breach date 06/03/2026, reported 11/20/2026). No other publisher read.
